system.description: Constructs are artificial peoples created through machinery, magic, alchemy, craftsmanship, or some combination of those methods. Their bodies may be made from metal, stone, wood, ceramic, crystal, synthetic flesh, or other designed materials.

nature.name: Artificial Nature
nature.text: You do not need to breathe or eat and do not sleep in the ordinary manner. Ordinary biological diseases and poisons do not affect you, though you must still rest and recover normally. Choose one Construct Species Trait. You may replace your chosen Species Trait during significant Downtime, representing modification or reconstruction of your body.

traits.name: Alternate Chassis
traits.text: Gain Climb 10 or Swim 10 through a body specifically designed for that form of Movement.

traits.name: Anchor Mode
traits.text: At the end of your Turn, you may anchor yourself to a stable surface. While anchored, your Movement is 0; you cannot voluntarily leave your space or gain voluntary extra Movement, including through Dash or other granted movement, unless an effect explicitly bypasses the anchor. Involuntary movement against you is reduced to 0. You may release the anchor at the start of your Turn.

traits.name: Integrated Tool
traits.text: Choose one ordinary Non-Combat Toolkit and incorporate it into your body. It does not consume Armory or Inventory capacity, cannot be disarmed, and remains available whenever the relevant portions of your body are functional.

traits.name: Internal Compartment
traits.text: Choose one small item of ordinary utility equipment within the Team's ordinary access. While installed inside your body, it does not consume Armory or Inventory capacity and is not discovered through casual observation. You may replace it during significant Downtime.

traits.name: Redundant Systems
traits.text: The first time each Adventure a Wound Condition or other effect would disable one of your limbs, Senses, or Movement modes, that function remains available for one minute (six Rounds).

traits.name: Reinforced Frame
traits.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. If you have not moved during the current turn, reduce it by 2 units instead.

traits.name: Sensor Suite
traits.text: Choose two: Low-Light Vision, Keen Hearing, Heat Perception, Vibration Sense, or a fully defined narrow Sense appropriate to the Campaign. Use Senses and Detection above. Within 2 units, creatures and objects cannot remain Hidden from you when a chosen Sense can detect them under its stated conditions; its blockers still apply.

traits.name: Utility Limb
traits.text: You possess an additional arm, tool mount, cable, or similar mechanism. It may hold and use one small item that can be used with one hand, other than a weapon or Guard. The item itself occupies equipment capacity normally. The limb does not grant additional Actions.
